author: Karl Rock
description: Locals call this plant Aak. It might look like just another shrub, but for generations, it has been treated as a vital part of their rural pharmacy. When livestock fall ill, the plant is harvested and burned, allowing the smoke to act as a traditional medicine. It is a fascinating reminder of how these communities have relied on the land around them for centuries, long before modern clinics existed.
title: Cows Smoke This Tree in Pakistan
